translations.translatedText: # Tuesday 21.9.2021 (radio)
Corona pass. Entry restrictions. Labour shortage. Cancer. Weather forecast.
## Corona pass

![Corona certificate with vaccination information, printed from the Omakanta service.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5000,h_2813,x_0,y_219/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-83156060ee7cf4d5328/1626242527)
Open image viewer
The corona certificate can be obtained from Omakanta. Photo: Silja Viitala / Yle

The government proposes a corona pass for Finland. The EU corona certificate works as the corona pass. The aim is that a corona pass can be required, for example, in restaurants, gyms, at public events and in museums.

A corona pass may not be needed much in Finland, because corona restrictions are being lifted in the autumn. The government says that the corona pass can be used if the corona situation worsens again.
The corona pass will come into use if Parliament approves the government's proposal.
## Entry restrictions

![A border guard directs a customer coming to Finland from Sweden to a test point at the Tornio border crossing.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_6240,h_3510,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-81368160b4fc52419cd/1622474278)
Open image viewer
Entry restrictions will be extended until the end of the year. Photo: Juuso Stoor / Yle
The government proposes that entry restrictions are extended until the end of the year.
People who come to Finland from abroad must have a certificate of either corona vaccinations, a negative corona test, or a certificate that they have had the corona disease.
Similar entry restrictions are still in use in many other EU countries too.
## Labour shortage
![Electrical circuits.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9177290)
Open image viewer
There is a shortage of workers in many fields. Photo: Scanfil
The labour shortage is growing in Finland. More Finns are working than before, but there are also more open jobs than before.

Many companies have a shortage of workers. For example, the technology industry association says that almost 10,000 new workers will be needed in the technology sector within a year. There is also a shortage of workers in other fields.
Many companies say that more labour must quickly be brought to Finland from abroad.
## Exercise for cancer patients

![Sonja Alanko, who has cancer, does exercises in front of a laptop.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_6000,h_3375,x_0,y_75/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-8558766148509f56e06/1632129259)
Open image viewer
Sonja Alanko has cancer. She does remote exercise in front of a computer. Photo: Minna Rosvall / Yle

Exercise is beneficial in the treatment of cancer patients. This has been noticed when remote exercise has been arranged for cancer patients. Cancer patients have also taken part in remote exercise on hospital wards.
Exercise helps cancer patients, because exercise increases muscle strength. Exercise also improves well-being and puts people in a good mood.

Physiotherapist **Marianne Himberg** says that cancer patients should move from the moment of diagnosis. Himberg hopes that guided remote exercise will be offered widely to cancer patients in Finland.
## Weather
![Wednesday's weather map.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12109609)
Open image viewer
The weather is now quite cold. September is often warmer than now.

The weather continues cool on Wednesday. In the south and central parts of the country it is partly cloudy or cloudy, but no rain falls. In western Lapland there may be light water or snow showers in places. The temperature on Wednesday is between 7 and 12 degrees, and in the northern part of the country between 5 and 9 degrees.
